changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan_reschedule_request r JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, maker_id, CASE WHEN date_format = 'dd MMMM yyyy' AND entered REGEXP '^[0-9]{1,2} (January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December) [0-9]{4}$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(entered, '%d %M %Y') WHEN date_format = 'yyyy-MM-dd' AND entered REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$' THEN STR_TO_DATE(entered, '%Y-%m-%d') ELSE DATE(made_on_date) END AS approved_on FROM ( SELECT c.resource_id, c.maker_id, c.made_on_date, IF(JSON_VALID(c.command_as_json), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.command_as_json, '$.dateFormat')), NULL) AS date_format, IF(JSON_VALID(c.command_as_json), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(c.command_as_json, '$.approvedOnDate')), NULL) AS entered, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.resource_id ORDER BY c.id DESC) AS rn FROM m_portfolio_command_source c WHERE c.entity_name = 'RESCHEDULELOAN' AND c.action_name = 'APPROVE' AND c.processing_result_enum = 1 ) latest WHERE rn = 1 ) approval ON approval.resource_id = r.id SET r.approved_on_date = approval.approved_on, r.approved_by_user_id = COALESCE(r.approved_by_user_id, approval.maker_id) WHERE r.status_enum IN (200, 800) AND r.approved_on_date IS NULL

UPDATE m_loan_reschedule_request r JOIN ( SELECT id FROM ( SELECT id, status_enum, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY id DESC) AS rn FROM m_loan_reschedule_request WHERE status_enum IN (200, 800) ) ranked WHERE rn = 1 AND status_enum = 200 ) latest ON latest.id = r.id JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = r.loan_id SET r.approved_on_date = l.rescheduledon_date WHERE r.approved_on_date IS NULL AND l.rescheduledon_date >= r.submitted_on_date
UPDATE m_loan_reschedule_request SET approved_on_date = submitted_on_date WHERE status_enum IN (200, 800) AND approved_on_date IS NULL

UPDATE m_loan_repayment_schedule_history h JOIN m_loan_reschedule_request r ON r.id = h.loan_reschedule_request_id SET h.superseded_on_date = r.approved_on_date WHERE h.superseded_on_date IS NULL AND r.status_enum IN (200, 800)
